parameters.query:
=SELECT a.id, a.email, a.nombre, a.rol, a.rol_nombre, a.rol_anterior, a.resumen, a.secciones_json,
       a.url_panel, a.asignado_por, uc.cids
  FROM usuarios_avisos_rol a
  JOIN users_config uc ON uc.id = a.user_id
   AND LOWER(TRIM(uc.email)) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = LOWER(TRIM(a.email)) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
  JOIN roles r ON r.id = uc.role_id
   AND r.name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = a.rol COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
 WHERE a.id = {{ $json.id }}
   AND a.enviado_at IS NULL
   AND a.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
 LIMIT 1
=UPDATE usuarios_avisos_rol SET enviado_at = NOW() WHERE id = {{ $('Armar correo').item.json.aviso_id }}
